response.overview: This hit-filled Motown Video Original is a fabulous fantasy that puts all new images to The Motown Sound. It all happens in the 1990's when every radio station has switched to video- except for one lone holdout. Only the mysterious Last DJ and the timeless original Motown recordings can save The Last Radio Station from extinction.  One in a series of exciting, new Motown Video Originals where the Motown Sound never looked so good.
response.title: The Last Radio Station
